rec.name: Testimonial Videos Section (Customer Video Carousel with Badge)
rec.status: Built — launched (implemented on Goldenstrawberry theme; customer briefed with Loom walkthrough)

what.text: A reusable theme section ("CRO | Global | Testimonial Videos", shown in the editor as "Testimonial Videos") that displays a row of customer testimonial videos with a thumbnail and play icon. It has a heading, a subheading, an optional CTA button and an optional round badge overlapping the top-right of the video row (e.g. "50.000+ customers love Golden Strawberry"). Videos are added as repeatable blocks, each with a video URL and a thumbnail image. On mobile the videos sit side by side in a horizontally scrolling row, and the second video is partly cut off.

why.text: Real customers talking on camera are strong social proof. They feel more authentic than written reviews and show the product in use. The round badge adds a quantified popularity claim ("50.000+ customers"), which creates a bandwagon effect and builds trust. Placing the section on the homepage answers the "why this brand?" question early. The optional CTA button lets the social proof lead directly into the next step.

how.text: In the Theme Editor, open the Home page, click Add section and choose "Testimonial Videos". Set the heading, subheading, text color and section background. Enter a button text and link; leave them empty if no button is wanted. Optionally enable the badge and set its text, text color and background color. Add one "Video" block per testimonial and enter the video URL, which must be a video file uploaded to the Shopify account (not an image link). Choose a thumbnail from Shopify media to show before playback. Set the border style (Rounded/Square). The play icon is customizable SVG code, with a default provided. A fix was added so the heading/subheading input is limited and the badge no longer overlaps the text when the button link is removed.

items: Button text (leave empty to hide the button)
Play button icon (SVG code, default provided)
Video block: Video thumbnail (image picker from Shopify media)

dependencies.text: Videos must be uploaded to the Shopify account (Files/Media) and linked by URL. Image URLs in the video field break playback (this caused an issue on slots 2 and 3). A thumbnail is chosen from Shopify media. No app is required. The section is part of the Sectionfy section library and was installed into the customer's theme copy ("NEW THEME - LIVE JAN25 - SST (Testimonial Video)"). Dev effort estimate: 5h.

items: Click-through rate on the section CTA button
Bounce rate / engagement time on the homepage
